title: Summarize a ticketing system migration
prompt: Summarize the following update in one sentence: The support team migrated to a new ticketing system this week, which is expected to reduce average response time from 6 hours to 2 hours once fully adopted.

metadata.notes: Correct: mentions the migration event and the expected improvement, ideally with both the before (6h) and after (2h) numbers.
metadata.grading_method: manual (reviewed 2026-09-23, V2.6 Phase 1) - the rubric's own wording ('ideally with both... numbers') is a soft bar, not a strict requirement; a strict AND-of-facts presence check would be stricter than the rubric itself intends, incorrectly failing a summary that's fine without the exact numbers.
